entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
This is ridiculous. I've been on hold for five minutes. Connect me to someone now!
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is David. How can I help you today?
Finally! I want to return these terrible cycling shoes I bought from you. They're complete junk.

I'm very sorry to hear you're not satisfied with your purchase. I can certainly look into return options for you. To get started, can I have your order number or the email address associated with your account?
Look, I don't have the order number handy! Just look up my account. My feet are covered in blisters from one ride! And the cleats were a nightmare to install. I want a refund, and I want it now!

I completely understand your frustration, and I'll do my best to resolve this quickly. Let me just pull up your account with your phone number... Okay, I see your recent order for the VeloPro Road Cycling Shoes, delivered 46 days ago. Is that correct?

46 days? So what? Your policy says 10 days! Are you trying to get out of this? Because if you are, I want to speak to your manager immediately. I'll make sure everyone on every cycling forum knows VeloFit sells garbage that injures people.

Not at all, sir. I apologize if it came across that way. I was just confirming the item. You are absolutely correct; our policy for these shoes is 10 days, so you are unfortunately outside the window for a full refund.

I'm processing that for you right now. I also see that you're a VIP member with us. I sincerely apologize for the poor experience and especially for the blisters they caused. I've initiated the return and you'll receive an email with a pre-paid shipping label within the next five minutes.
A full refund, you said? Back to my credit card?

Yes, a full refund to your original payment method once we receive the item. And as a gesture of our apology for the trouble, I've also added a $25 VeloFit credit to your account for any future purchase. There's no expiration on that.
Fine. A credit and the refund. That's acceptable. Make sure that email comes through.
It has just been sent. You should see it shortly. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
